popCulture.title: Argonautica (Mopsus)
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius’ seer — son of Ampycus, Apollo-trained — sails with Jason, reads bird-omens in the storm, and dies of a serpent’s bite in Libya. Carefully distinct from the later Colophonian Mopsus who outprophesied Calchas.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (Argonauts)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus lists Mopsus among the Argonauts — the Ampycid augur of the handbook roster that fed medieval and modern Jason cycles.
